scripts.test: files=$(find src \( -name '*.test.ts' -o -name '*.test.tsx' \) ! -name '*.integration.test.ts'); if [ -z "$files" ]; then echo 'no test files found' >&2; exit 1; fi; node --import tsx --test $files
scripts.test:coverage: files=$(find src \( -name '*.test.ts' -o -name '*.test.tsx' \) ! -name '*.integration.test.ts'); if [ -z "$files" ]; then echo 'no test files found' >&2; exit 1; fi; c8 -r text -r lcov -r html -x '**/*.test.*' node --import tsx --test $files
scripts.test:integration: files=$(find src -name '*.integration.test.ts'); if [ -z "$files" ]; then echo 'no integration test files found' >&2; exit 1; fi; node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 $files
